pageDescription: Everyone has a gift to share. Whether at CTK, in our community, or around the world—find your place to serve.
hubDescription: From Sunday morning to global missions, there's a place for you.
volunteerDescription: Find your place to serve within our church family.
volunteerCtaDescription: Contact us to learn more about volunteer opportunities.
safeguardingDescription: Volunteers working with children complete background checks and MinistrySafe training to ensure a safe environment for everyone.
missionsDescription: CTK partners with mission organizations to serve locally in St. Augustine, nationally across the U.S., and globally around the world.
deafChurchDescription: CTK serves as an Anchor Church for DeafChurch Together, bringing Anglican liturgy to the Deaf community through weekly ASL services. Founded by Fr. Bob and Deacon Kathy Ayres, this ministry connects Deaf believers across Northeast Florida.
